sources.name: Thumbtack Pro self-serve webhooks
sources.name_es: Webhooks de Thumbtack Pro para autoservicio
sources.summary_es: Principal opción para solicitudes residenciales y comerciales que lleguen a la cuenta Pro de Sample Cleaning Company; no permite buscar todo el mercado local. El titular configura un webhook HTTPS de un solo negocio; los eventos no están firmados, pueden repetirse y requieren autenticación del receptor e idempotencia. El titular debe autorizarlo. Los documentos revisados no indican un plazo numérico de retención: debe definirse antes de activarlo. El costo por contacto depende del servicio y mercado; la entrega es en tiempo real. Dificultad media; el adaptador existente continúa limitado a pruebas.
sources.commercial_relevance: Very high for residential, deep, recurring and commercial service requests routed to Sample Cleaning Company's enrolled Pro account.
sources.geographic_coverage: The connected Pro business receives leads matched to its account settings; no public market-wide Sample City One/Sample City Two search.
sources.access_method: Owner configures lead webhooks in the Pro account; HTTPS POST to an owner-controlled receiver.
sources.api_availability: Self-serve webhook for one business; separate partner API exists for multi-business integrations.
sources.authentication_requirements: Self-serve path has no OAuth; receiver must use configured Basic Auth or a custom header because events are unsigned. HTTPS receiver is required.
sources.permission_and_terms_limitations: Account holder authorization required. Minimize private lead data and honor platform, privacy and retention limits. Do not treat fixture mapping as a live receiver.
sources.data_retention: The reviewed self-serve webhook docs do not state a numeric retention period. Before enabling, set a documented minimum retention period with the account holder, store only fields needed for qualification and deduplication, and honor applicable privacy, deletion and platform-term duties.
sources.data_retention_es: La guía de webhooks revisada no fija un plazo numérico. Antes de activar el receptor, el titular debe definir y documentar un plazo mínimo, guardar solo datos necesarios para calificar y detectar duplicados, y atender las obligaciones de privacidad y eliminación.
sources.cost: Lead price varies by service and market; the lead event/API can include the price. No local quote was available without account access.
sources.data_freshness: New lead event is real time; duplicate delivery can occur; webhook does not report later lead status changes.
sources.implementation_difficulty: MEDIUM; authenticated HTTPS receiver, bounded validation, idempotency, retention and delivery handling.
sources.pilot_note: No account-holder authorization or production HTTPS receiver is configured. Existing adapter remains fixture-only.
sources.pilot_note_es: Sin autorización del titular ni receptor HTTPS de producción. El adaptador existente sigue limitado a pruebas.

sources.name: Turno Cleaner Marketplace
sources.summary_es: Muy pertinente para limpieza de alojamientos vacacionales y relaciones con anfitriones. Requiere solicitud del limpiador y completar los pasos de identidad, referencias, perfil y alta; en EE. UU. exige una verificación de antecedentes pagada. Las ofertas se reciben y responden dentro de Turno; son búsquedas del anfitrión, no trabajos con fecha garantizada. No se verificó una API para buscar ofertas. Sus términos prohíben bots y no permiten guardar datos personales del solicitante sin consentimiento expreso. Postular es gratis; los pagos del mercado tienen una comisión del 5 % y el precio de la verificación no figura en la FAQ revisada. Uso manual.
sources.commercial_relevance: Very high for vacation-rental turnover cleaning and ongoing host-cleaner relationships.
sources.geographic_coverage: Cleaner applies with an explicit service area and travel range; owner must choose Sample City One and Sample City Two deliberately.
sources.access_method: The cleaner must be at least 18, apply with cleaning experience, a selected service-area address and 5–50 mile travel range, profile photo/bio, and mandatory references. After approval, complete native account setup, payout account, tutorial and welcome call; US cleaners must also buy a Turno background-check badge. Then use native web/app/email/push offer notifications and bid in Turno.
sources.api_availability: Public External API documentation exists; no cleaner marketplace offer search endpoint was documented in the reviewed API reference.
sources.authentication_requirements: Approved cleaner account, ID, recent profile picture, experience bio and references. In the US, pass the required background check and complete all account-setup steps before bidding.
sources.permission_and_terms_limitations: Cleaner terms prohibit bots, scrapers, scripts and unauthorized collection; personal data about requesters may not be stored without express consent. Keep offers and negotiation in Turno.
sources.data_retention: Do not export or retain requester personal data without express consent. Keep offer details and negotiation in Turno; only a manually approved, redacted reference may enter the AEOS preview.
sources.data_retention_es: No exportar ni conservar datos personales de quien solicita el servicio sin consentimiento expreso. Mantener ofertas y negociación en Turno; para la vista previa de AEOS, usar solo una referencia redactada y revisada manualmente.
sources.cost: No fee to bid. US marketplace requires a paid Turno background-check request; its price was not published in the reviewed FAQ. Marketplace payments have a 5% platform fee.
sources.data_freshness: Native notifications arrive when a host opens a cleaner search in the configured area. An offer starts a relationship and is not a dated job request.
sources.implementation_difficulty: MANUAL; account participation and native notifications only.
sources.pilot_note: No account authorization or manual offer evidence was supplied; no authenticated pages were accessed.
sources.pilot_note_es: No se proporcionó autorización de cuenta ni evidencia manual de ofertas; no se accedió a páginas autenticadas.

sources.data_retention_es: No se autoriza recopilación. Para un caso manual permitido, conservar solo la URL redactada y la evidencia mínima de revisión; no se estableció un plazo numérico de conservación.

El costo comercial no está publicado; fecha y estado deben volver a comprobarse. Dificultad alta por aprobación, OAuth y reglas de contenido, retención y eliminación.

sources.geographic_coverage: Local subreddits and explicit city/state terms; historical posts are not current demand.
sources.access_method: Official Data API with registered/approved access and OAuth; no scraping or search-engine result extraction.

sources.authentication_requirements: Registered/approved developer access; valid API access information. Commercial access requires a separate agreement.
sources.permission_and_terms_limitations: Reddit's Data API and Developer Terms restrict commercial use absent separate written approval. User content use and retention must remain within the approved use case.
sources.data_retention: No commercial agreement or API access exists. If approved later, follow the agreement's retention, deletion and user-content rules; this pilot has no independent retention allowance.
sources.data_retention_es: No existe acuerdo comercial ni acceso API. Si se aprueba en el futuro, cumplir las reglas del acuerdo sobre conservación, eliminación y contenido de usuarios; este piloto no concede por sí mismo permiso para conservar datos.

sources.data_freshness: Post timestamps can be observed through authorized API access; current openness still requires revalidation.

sources.pilot_note: No commercial data agreement or API access was supplied; no Reddit API request was made.

sources.name: City of Sample City One and City of Sample City Two OpenGov procurement portals
sources.name_es: Portales de contratación OpenGov de Sample City One y Sample City Two
sources.summary_es: Fuente de avisos públicos para limpieza de oficinas, edificios y otras instalaciones. Las páginas oficiales municipales se pudieron consultar, pero los portales enlazados devolvieron HTTP 403; no se repitieron las solicitudes ni se intentó eludir el bloqueo. No se verificó una API pública anónima. Sample City Two indica que el registro y la consulta/respuesta son gratuitos; el costo del portal de Sample City One no quedó documentado. Revisar manualmente fechas oficiales o usar los avisos por correo de la ciudad. Sin proyectos capturados; integración manual.
sources.commercial_relevance: High for explicit office, janitorial and commercial facility solicitations; contract size and eligibility may exceed reported capacity.
sources.geographic_coverage: Two separate local-government portals; review Sample City One and Sample City Two independently.
sources.access_method: Official city procurement pages direct vendors to public OpenGov project lists and native email notices.
sources.api_availability: OpenGov publishes account-scoped procurement APIs, but no public anonymous opportunity-search API for these city bid portals was verified.
sources.authentication_requirements: Public viewing is described by the cities; vendor registration/submission follows each portal's account process. Sample City Two says registration and viewing/responding are free.
sources.permission_and_terms_limitations: Do not reverse engineer portal endpoints. During this review both city portal pages returned HTTP 403 through the public retrieval path, so their projects were not queried or bypassed.
sources.data_retention: No projects were retrieved. For a manually reviewed public solicitation, retain the public solicitation ID, issuer, scope, deadline, eligibility, contract facts and source URL; avoid personal contact data and delete stale working copies when no longer needed. No source-specific numeric period was established.
sources.data_retention_es: No se obtuvieron avisos. Para una licitación pública revisada manualmente, guardar el ID, entidad, alcance, fecha límite, elegibilidad, datos contractuales y URL; evitar datos personales de contacto y borrar copias de trabajo obsoletas. No se estableció un plazo numérico propio de la fuente.
sources.cost: Sample City Two vendor registration is stated to be free; no separate fee to view or respond is indicated. Sample City One portal cost was not documented in the reviewed page.
sources.data_freshness: Official notices show release and deadline dates; native email notices are available after registration.
sources.implementation_difficulty: LOW for manual review; HIGH/UNKNOWN for an API integration without a documented public feed.
sources.pilot_note: City pages were accessible; embedded OpenGov portal requests returned HTTP 403. No retries or circumvention were attempted.
sources.pilot_note_es: Las páginas municipales estaban accesibles; los portales OpenGov devolvieron HTTP 403. No hubo reintentos ni elusión.

market_checks.finding: The City says its OpenGov portal lists current solicitations, deadlines and vendor resources.
OpenGov and Bidnet are both in use during transition; the City offers free vendor registration and notices.

sources.name: SAM.gov federal contract opportunities
sources.name_es: Oportunidades federales de contratación en SAM.gov
sources.summary_es: Puede incluir contratos federales de limpieza, pero solo se deben considerar avisos locales que encajen con la capacidad y elegibilidad. La API oficial requiere clave personal y filtros de códigos postales aprobados por el titular para cada ciudad; no se consultó sin esos datos y no se hará una búsqueda estatal amplia. No se documentó tarifa de acceso. La documentación indica actualización diaria de avisos activos; dificultad media por credenciales, paginación y revisión de anexos.
sources.commercial_relevance: High for federal janitorial opportunities, but only locally suitable notices should be retained and capacity/eligibility review is mandatory.
sources.geographic_coverage: Nationwide API supports state and ZIP filters; this pilot requires exact owner-approved local filters and must not query all Example Region.
sources.access_method: Official Get Opportunities Public API v2; two bounded city-specific query sets require owner-confirmed ZIP filters.
sources.api_availability: Documented public API. The API requires postedFrom and postedTo; request pagination is explicit and max limit is 1000.
sources.authentication_requirements: A registered SAM.gov user must create a personal public API key in Account Details.
sources.permission_and_terms_limitations: Use the official API and role-based rate limits. No local query was sent because no API key or city-specific ZIP allowlist is configured.
sources.data_retention: No records were retrieved. A future connector must retain only fields needed to evaluate and track public solicitations, follow applicable federal terms and privacy obligations, and define a documented retention/deletion schedule before querying.
sources.data_retention_es: No se obtuvieron registros. Un conector futuro debe guardar solo campos necesarios para evaluar y seguir avisos públicos, cumplir las condiciones federales y de privacidad aplicables, y documentar un calendario de conservación y eliminación antes de consultar la API.
sources.cost: No API access fee was documented; account/API key required.
sources.data_freshness: Active notices are updated daily; archived notices weekly, per API documentation.
sources.implementation_difficulty: MEDIUM; API key handling, local ZIP targeting, bounded paging, normalization, status and attachment review.
sources.pilot_note: No API key is configured and a city-specific ZIP allowlist was not provided; no nationwide or statewide query was made.
sources.pilot_note_es: No hay clave API ni lista de códigos postales autorizada por ciudad; no se hizo una búsqueda nacional o estatal.

Bark usa créditos; la matriz registra US$ 2,35 por crédito según la revisión previa y el consumo por solicitud varía. Angi fija precios por cuenta y Yelp limita su API a socios. No se autorizó gasto ni exportación cruzada; confirmar costos vigentes antes de pagar. Acceso manual.
